quote: A MRPC (Multi-Gap Resistive Plate Chamber) detector serving as a time-of-flight (TOF) detector for pion (hadron) identification.

Here, an analysis and interpretation of 47.4 days of live time data accrued with DRIFT-IId (the latest DRIFT-II detector) filled with partial pressures of 30 Torr CS2 and 10 Torr CF4 is presented.
Background-free operation was made possible by the addition of 1 Torr of O2 to the nominal 30:10 Torr CS2:CF4 DRIFT gas.
